newsitem.title: CHINA: Pearl Oriental up on red-chip link hopes.
newsitem.headline: Pearl Oriental up on red-chip link hopes.

text.p: Shares of Pearl Oriental Holdings Ltd rose on hopes of participation by Chinese interests in the company, brokers said on Tuesday.
"Hope of Chinese participation boosted demand for the stock," said Anthony Mak, sales director at Vickers Ballas.
The shares were up HK$0.15 or 12.82 percent at HK$1.32 in mid-morning after they hit a morning high of HK$1.42.
Volume was 136.77 million shares worth HK$183.69 million.

The property developer and hotelier said earlier its directors had held informal discussions over the past few months with three red-chip firms regarding possible investment in Pearl Oriental or cooperation with the company.
